programme.title: Le sang du cartel
programme.desc: Lucas, adolescent dans une bande de D.C., voit une chance de sauver son frère grâce à un ancien combattant.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Un petit confiseur est furieux de découvrir qu'une grande entreprise de confiserie s'installe dans les environs. Mais tout se complique lorsqu'une romance improbable naît avec sa nouvelle concurrente.

programme.title: Célibataire cherche l'amour
programme.desc: Lucy Neal, une violoniste, se remet en question après que son ex petit ami ait décidé de rompre, la jugeant trop frigide. Afin de lui prouver le contraire, elle se lance dans la création d'une liste de choses “sexy” à réaliser.

programme.title: Témoin à Louer
programme.desc: Doug Harris a un vrai problème: le jeune homme, qui n'a pas une vie sociale très riche, est sur le point de se marier, mais n'a pas de témoin.

programme.title: La Fille du Président
programme.desc: La fille du Président des Etats-Unis insiste pour suivre une scolarité normale, sans la surveillance des services secrets. Un agent se fait donc passer pour un étudiant afin de la protéger.

programme.title: Jonas
programme.desc: La vie de Jonas a été bouleversée alors qu'il avait 14 ans par sa rencontre avec Nathan, un ami solaire qui intrigue et ose à la fois. Désormais trentenaire, ce souvenir le hante encore.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: The story of a long-lost book that mysteriously reappears and connects an old man searching for his son with a girl seeking a cure for her mother's loneliness.

programme.title: Hannah mangold
programme.desc: Hannah est suspendue de ses fonctions et trie les dossiers dans les archives du Bureau. Elle n'a pas eu d'hallucination depuis un certain temps et se croit presque en bonne santé. Lucy, quant à elle, a une noix dure à casser : un couple de Berlin a disparu dans les vastes forêts de l'Uckermark. Ils sont venus d'une fête médiévale, ont traversé un village en voiture, puis se sont perdus de vue. Bien qu'Ulf Habermann lui ait fait comprendre à plusieurs reprises qu'elle devait laisser l'affaire à ses collègues du Brandebourg, Lucy se consacre à la recherche de ces deux personnes par intérêt personnel.

programme.title: Après Lucia
programme.desc: Lucia est morte dans un accident de voiture il y a six mois depuis, son mari Roberto et sa fille Alejandra, tentent de surmonter ce deuil. Afin de prendre un nouveau départ, Roberto décide de s'installer à Mexico. Alejandra se retrouve, nouvelle, dans une classe. Plus jolie, plus brillante, elle est rapidement la cible d'envie et de jalousie de la part de ses camarades. Refusant d'en parler à son père, elle devient une proie, un bouc émissaire.

programme.title: Mes Deux amours
programme.desc: Hadrien se lance à la recherche de la femme qu'il aime, Barbara, qui a disparu sans lui donner de nouvelles. Personne ne veut entendre ses angoisses sauf un autre homme, qui affirme à Hadrien que la femme de sa vie est la sienne... La rencontre entre les deux amants de Barbara a lieu à l'endroit où elle a été aperçue pour la dernière fois : la bergerie dont elle a hérité de sa mère. Hadrien Darcourt est arrivé en 4x4, Emmanuel Devailly, en stop. Hadrien est encore en costume, Emmanuel est déjà en tenue de campagne. Hadrien a fait appel à la gendarmerie, Emmanuel à son instinct. Bref, tout les oppose, mais ils aiment tous deux Barbara Cantarella, 45 ans, grand reporter

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: L'Amour à la Carte
programme.desc: Une cheffe audacieuse tombe amoureuse de l'héritier improbable d'une chaîne de fast-food mexicain.

programme.title: Dans la Tête d'Alan Moore
programme.desc: La vie d'une légende de la BD et de la contre-culture.

programme.title: Sortie Mortelle
programme.desc: Des inconnus sont piégés dans une maison où un événement terrible a eu lieu il y a 100 ans.

programme.title: Charlie Says
programme.desc: Le film traite de charles manson, et en particulier l'influence qu'il a eu sur une jeune femme de 19 ans.

programme.title: Walt Avant Mickey
programme.desc: Walt Disney surmonte les obstacles de son enfance, créant Mickey Mouse et un empire légendaire.

programme.title: Bad Teacher (2011)
programme.desc: Après avoir été plaquée par son fiancé, une jeune enseignante de collège vulgaire se met en tête de séduire un de ses collègues. Mais la jeune femme est confrontée à une rivale de taille, très appréciée des autres.

programme.title: Premiers Pas Dans La Mafia
programme.desc: A peine arrivé à New York, Clark Kellogg, jeune étudiant en cinéma, se fait détrousser par un faux chauffeur de taxi. Mais cet incident l'amène à rencontrer Carmine Sabatini, mafieux sosie du Parrain, qui lui confie une mission insolite : transporter un mystérieux colis destiné à une assemblée secrète de gourmets...

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: En 1948, Paul Child, fonctionnaire américain, arrive à Paris avec son épouse, Julia. Cherchant une occupation dans la capitale française, celle-ci s'inscrit à des cours de cuisine et prend goût à concocter des plats pour son époux et leurs amis. de cette expérience naît un livre de recettes qui rencontre un immense succès. de nos jours, Julie Powell, employée trentenaire de New York, a l'impression de tourner en rond. Son métier l'ennuie et elle jalouse la réussite de ses amies. Pour se divertir, et sur le conseil de son mari Eric, elle décide de lancer un blog culinaire. Elle se donne 365 jours pour réaliser toutes les recettes de Julia Child...

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Pour impressionner sa petite amie Vanessa et a la suite d'un quiproquo, Sonny, celibataire endurci, fait croire qu'il est le pere naturel de Julian, un jeune garcon de cinq ans qu'il adopte. C'est la catastrophe et l'enfer des nuits detruites, des seances insupportables de calins sans parler de la chanson du Kangourou, qui font decouvrir a Sony un monde qu'il ignorait totalement.

programme.title: 30 Ans Sinon Rien
programme.desc: Jenna, adolescente de treize ans qui rêve de devenir célèbre, s'enferme dans un placard après avoir subi une expérience humiliante. Lorsqu'elle se décide enfin de sortir de sa cachette, elle s'aperçoit que, par un phénomène extraordinaire et inexplicable, elle est sur le point de célébrer son trentième anniversaire et qu'elle est devenue extrêmement belle et populaire.Alors que Jenna commence à profiter de sa toute nouvelle vie, elle découvre que celui auquel elle tenait tant n'est plus là. Non seulement elle n'a plus aucune nouvelle de Matt, mais elle apprend qu'il s'apprête à épouser une autre demoiselle...

programme.title: Qui a tué Maggie Moore(s)?
programme.desc: Le chef de police Sanders enquête sur les meurtres étranges de deux femmes portant le même nom et démêle un réseau de mensonges dans une petite ville.

programme.title: On sera 2!
programme.desc: Afin de survivre à la fièvre des mariages de l'été, les vieux amis célibataires Ben et Alice, décident de devenir l'accompagnant de l'autre à chaque fois que l'un d'entre eux sera invité.

programme.title: The Beach Bum
programme.desc: The Beach Bum est une comédie trépidante et originale, réalisée par Harmony Korine, à qui l'on doit aussi Spring Breakers et Gummo, entre autres. Entourée d'un casting de stars, Korine signe une déclaration d'amour aux comédies de type « stoner » ainsi qu'à la beauté de la vie.

programme.title: Une famille 2 en 1
programme.desc: Veuf, Frank se rend à une réunion d'anciens étudiants et y retrouve Helen, son ex-petite amie, elle aussi restée seule après le décès de son mari. Le courant passe immédiatement et le couple décide rapidement de s'installer ensemble.

programme.title: Bill et Ted sauvent l'univers
programme.desc: Les enjeux n'ont jamais été aussi grands pour Bill et Ted qui, toujours désireux de réaliser leur destin rock and roll, s'embarquent dans une nouvelle aventure lorsqu'un visiteur les prévient que seule leur chanson peut sauver la vie tell.

programme.title: Ciakmull, le bâtard de Dodge City
programme.desc: Un jeune homme qui a perdu la mémoire s'échappe de prison avec trois autres détenus.

programme.title: Les Vengeurs de l'Ave Maria
programme.desc: Mann est un tireur informé par un ami d'enfance que son père a été assassiné des années plus tôt par sa mère et son amant.

programme.title: Le Retour de Sabata
programme.desc: Les citoyens de Hobsonville engagent Sabata pour les débarrasser du clan McIntock, qui les taxe de force et illégalement sous le prétexte du développement de la ville.

programme.title: La Chevauchée des bannis
programme.desc: Blaise Starrett est un éleveur en conflit avec les propriétaires terriens lorsque des hors-la-loi attaquent la petite ville.

programme.title: Calibre 32
programme.desc: Super cool Silver tue les sept membres d'un gang masqué, un par un.

programme.title: Django Kill... Tire encore si tu peux
programme.desc: Diverses factions, dont un bandit métis, une bande de cow-boys homosexuels et un prêtre, se disputent l'or volé dans une ville surréaliste.

programme.title: Je vais... je tire... et je reviens
programme.desc: Un gang dérobe une cargaison d'or dans un train. Un soi-disant chasseur de primes est envoyé à la recherche des voleurs et décide de les laisser le conduire jusqu'à l'or.

programme.title: Hercule contre les tyrans de Babylone
programme.desc: Le roi Shalmaneser, Assur et sa sœur sorcière Tanit, tyrans de Babylone, retiennent prisonniers des Hellènes, dont Esperia, reine d'Hellas. Hercule intervient pour la sauver, punir les tyrans cruels et libérer le peuple.

programme.title: Winnetou II : LE TRESOR DES MONTAGNES BLEUES
programme.desc: Forester, un impitoyable baron du pétrole, veut déclencher une guerre entre les tribus amérindiennes et les hommes blancs. Old Shatterhand, Winnetou et leur acolyte Castlepool tentent de l'empêcher.

programme.title: L'Apocalypse
programme.desc: Alors qu'un astéroïde menace de s'écraser sur la Terre, Jason et Ashley recherchent en vain leur petite fille disparue. Face à la panique qui s'empare de la population, ils doivent garder la tête froide car leur temps est compté. Réussiront-ils à la retrouver saine et sauve avant la fin du monde ?

programme.title: Supergrid
programme.desc: Les conglomérats miniers ont transformé le Canada en un désert. Deux frères doivent emprunter la même route qui a coûté la vie à leur soeur dans leur quête pour livrer une mystérieuse cargaison. En route, ils doivent affronter des pirates de la route et des gangs rebelles.

programme.title: Pterodactyl
programme.desc: Tandis qu'un commando d'élite de l'armée américaine tend une embuscade à des rebelles, le professeur Lovecraft guide plusieurs de ses élèves dans une mission archéologique. Une étudiante est attaquée par un ptérodactyle.

programme.title: Le Lac Maudit
programme.desc: Une famille en vacances renverse la situation face à un tireur de masse qui prétend combattre des forces démoniaques.

programme.title: Storm Chasers
programme.desc: Un ingénieur négligé est envoyé en Alaska pour vérifier l'affirmation d'un scientifique excentrique selon laquelle la capture de la foudre peut constituer une nouvelle source d'énergie renouvelable.

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: Un groupe d'amis part en week-end à la campagne, mais découvre qu'un chasseur local leur pose problème. Ceci dit, cela n'est rien face à l'invasion extraterrestre qui menace la Terre.

programme.title: Sentinel
programme.desc: Des années après qu'une invasion extraterrestre a presque anéanti l'humanité, réfugiés dans une base secrète sur la Lune, trois héros décident de voyager dans le temps dans une tentative désespérée de sauver les survivants. Mais ils ignorent que le Sentinelle les attend.

programme.title: Perfect Weapon
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, un agent-assassin d'une organisation secrète au service d'un gouvernement totalitaire échoue dans une mission et doit fuir ses employeurs.

programme.title: Snow White and the 7 Samurai
programme.desc: Laissée pour morte, Blanche-Neige est recueillie par une équipe d'assassins.

programme.title: La Nuit du Templier
programme.desc: Le chevalier médiéval Lord Gregoire, trahi par son propre conseiller et ses guerriers pour une abondance d'or et de richesses, jure qu'après que ces traîtres auront profité de dix vies d'excès, il se vengera dans le sang.

programme.title: Reign of Fire
programme.desc: "Quand Game of Thrones rencontre Le Seigneur des Anneaux"

programme.title: Robert The Bruce
programme.desc: Écosse 1306 : Après la mort du chef de guerre Richard Wallace, qui avait mené à la victoire face aux anglais à la Bataille de Stirling, Robert Bruce, comte de Carrick, reprend le flambeau de la lutte pour l'indépendance.

programme.title: Les 3 crimes de West Memphis
programme.desc: Les meurtres brutaux de 3 jeunes enfants déclenchent le procès controversé d' adolescents accusés.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Un jeune homme lutte pour retrouver son amour perdu lors de la construction du mur de Berlin.

programme.title: The book of love
programme.desc: Un architecte aide une jeune sans-abri qui rêve de traverser l'océan sur un radeau fait maison.

programme.title: Judicial Indiscretion
programme.desc: Juge nommée à la Cour suprême, Monica Barrett est la cible d'un psychopathe.

programme.title: House of Sand and Fog
programme.desc: Une épouse abandonnée et expulsée de sa maison, entre dans un conflit tragique avec les nouveaux propriétaires de la maison.

programme.title: Gotti
programme.desc: Au milieu des années 1980, John Gotti devient le parrain de la famille Gambino, l'une des cinq familles de la mafia italo-américaine de New York. Son fils John Junior assiste à sa montée et à sa chute.

programme.title: Au nom des femmes
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de Judy Wood, une avocate qui a changé le droit d'asile américain pour sauver la vie de femmes immigrantes.

programme.title: Undercover – Une Histoire Vraie
programme.desc: UNDERCOVER est tiré de l'émouvante histoire vraie d'un père ouvrier et de son fils adolescent, Rick Wershe Jr., qui devint informateur pour le FBI puis dealer de drogue, avant d'être abandonné par ceux qui l'avaient utilisé, et condamné à perpétuité.

programme.title: Mafia Inc
programme.desc: Les Gamache habillent la famille mafieuse Paternò. Vince veut faire ses preuves auprès du parrain…

programme.title: Le tueur de l'autoroute
programme.desc: Un père de famille se retrouve poursuivi par le conducteur d'un van qu'il a collé de trop près.

programme.title: En ce moment sur Box Office Action
programme.desc: Découvrez les bandes annonces des films à l'affiche sur les chaînes Box Office

programme.title: Jack Strong
programme.desc: L'espion Ryszard Kuklinski, informe les Américains des plus grands secrets du bloc communiste.

programme.title: Invincible Dragon
programme.desc: Un agent infiltré, tatoué d'un dragon dans le dos, s'est fait connaître en aidant la police à résoudre des cas mystérieux. Toutefois, son tempérament le mène à se battre régulièrement, et l'un de ses adversaires se trouve être un vétéran de l'armée américaine qui a un lien secret avec son passé.

programme.title: The Last Victim
programme.desc: Hickey, Sheriff d'une petite ville américaine, doit résoudre le pire cas de sa carrière lorsqu'un horrible crime est commis par un gang local ultra-violent.

programme.title: Runaway
programme.desc: Quand la famille de Luna est tuée de sang-froid lors de vacances à la montagne. Luna a la possibilité de fuir le pays. Mais d'abord, elle veut se venger.

programme.title: Time Out
programme.desc: Justin Timberlake et Amanda Seyfried sont les vedettes de ce thriller de science-fiction se déroulant dans un monde futur où le vieillissement s'arrête à 25 ans, et où la seule façon de rester en vie est de voler plus de temps.

programme.title: Mission diplomatique
programme.desc: Le lieutenant colonel Bill Kelly prépare son équipe à faire face à un terrible danger. En effet, les Sea Dragons doivent stopper les agissements d'un ambassadeur africain qui possède suffisamment de plutonium pour construire une arme nucléaire...

programme.title: Kidnapping de haut vol
programme.desc: Une mission de routine en hélicoptère tourne au drame pour Annalisa et AJ. Une tentative de prise d'otages conduit l'un d'eux dans l'océan et l'autre sur une île déserte...

programme.title: Bloodfight
programme.desc: En arrivant à Hong Kong, une Américaine est battue et agressée par des voyous. Elle est prise en charge par un maître d'arts martiaux qui l'entraîne à une formidable compétition de combat connue sous le nom de Kumite.

programme.title: Le Dernier Envol
programme.desc: Un groupe de pilotes teste un nouveau type d'armes, des missiles installés sur des F-18...

programme.title: À balles réelles
programme.desc: Un exercice de routine tourne au drame. Les membres de l'équipe de Bill Kelly vont devoir enclencher une course contre la montre...

programme.title: Banlieue interdite

Près de 30 ans plus tard, deux webreporters rouvrent l'enquête pour découvrir ce qui s'est réellement passé.

programme.title: Mad Heidi

programme.title: Le Masque du Démon

Deux siècles plus tard, la malédiction se réalise : les vampires reviennent à la vie et recommencent à semer la terreur et la mort...

programme.title: The Lovers

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: Après la mort de ses parents, Ty rentre d'Irak où il était soldat pour s'occuper de son petit frère. Pour faire face aux factures, il accepte de travailler comme convoyeur de fonds pour la société qui employait son père. Au dernier jour de sa période d'essai, Ty se voit proposer par Cochrane, son chef d'équipe, de voler les 42 millions de dollars qu'ils doivent bientôt transporter. Le plan est aussi simple que génial : pas d'armes, pas de victimes, pas de violence, et aucune preuve... Toute l'équipe est dans le coup. D'abord réticent, Ty finit par accepter. Le jour J, le plan se déroule sans accrocs, jusqu'à ce qu'un imprévu fasse tout déraper...

programme.title: Nightmare Island

programme.title: Colours of Nature

For us the beautiful and varied shades of the animal kingdom form a spec-tacular kaleidoscope of colours. With all the diversity in the world, sit back and enjoy all the col-ours of the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Defending the Family

Some fight for their own with lethal jaws, whilst others get in help, making use of neighbourhood bodyguards for hire. Some rely on close friends to help them out and others choose to isolate themselves in a fortress instead. Whatever their plan for a safe home, one thing's for sure - animals will stop at nothing to defend their families.

What's more, the power of nature tests our limits, opens our eyes and heals our hearts in equal measure. So why try to resist such a beautiful, exciting and enlightening siren song? programme.title: Fight for Territory

Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for! From lion scraps to insect warfare, these conflicts can provide us with the most remarkable spectacles in the animal kingdom.

As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

programme.title: Gronland

Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Mountains
programme.desc: A mother lynx feeds on freshly caught prey with her cubs, agile chamoix leap along mountain ledges, bee-eaters dig nesting holes in vineyards, black storks bring up their young on narrow ridges. From the rugged peaks of the Alps and the dark woods of the Black Forest to the sandstone cliffs of Saxonian Switzerland, Germany's mountains are home to very special animals. The episode Mountains from the four-part series Wild Germany shows a world full of breath-taking images. We witness the first few days of baby marmots in Alpine meadows, inexperienced and unaware of the dangers lurking outside the den. The opportunity that the golden eagle in the cliff face has been waiting for. Taking to the air, it glides over the steeply sloping pasture. The older marmots recognize the danger and send out shrill alarm whistles. Will the younger marmots heed the warnings in time? It's been more than 150 years since the last lynx was seen in Germany. After a reintroduction project in the Czech Republic, the first big cats crossed the border into the Bavarian forest. Similar projects in the Harz mountains have also brought the lynx back to Northern Germany. Only 30km South of Dresden, majestic table mountains stretch into the sky: Saxonian Switzerland with its unspoilt rocky cliffs and towers. Habitat of peregrine falcons and white-throated dippers, as well as the shy and seldom seen dormouse. The spectacular beauty and diversity of form of the Elbe Sandstone Mountains are unique in Europe. The film shows the magnificence of the mountains in the different seasons and the rich variety of flora and fauna. Unique animal footage rounds off the portrait of landscapes which have much more than just barren rocks to offer.

programme.title: Between Finland and Sweden
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest ocean in the world and first evolved after the last Ice Age. We think we know everything about it, yet still it has many surprises in store. Wind and waves still shape the shores of the Baltic Sea to this day. The third episode takes us to the Bay of Bothnia. More than double the size of the Netherlands, it is the most unknown region of the Baltic Sea. In the winter, the Baltic Sea freezes over at a length of 300 kilometres. In this 1-metre-thick ice tank, the third species of seal - alongside the grey seal and common seal - copes well with the Baltic Sea. The ringed seal is perfectly adapted to the Arctic winter and carves out breathing holes into the ice. More than 10,000 of the animals still live between Sweden and Finland. The Bay of Bothnia only has a salt content of just 1%, which is why it freezes quicker than other regions of the Baltic Sea. Many rivers disembogue here and “sweeten” the sea. The Tornio is the longest natural river in Europe. It forms the border between Sweden and Finland. Even when frost is severe, the Kukkolaforsen rapids in Sweden never freeze over, otters go hunting here. When it gets dark in the winter, solar winds conjure colourful light effects in the Baltic Sea sky. The Aurora Borealis can be seen in the northern regions of the Baltic Sea as of mid-October. The coast of Lapland is also the home of the reindeer. The Sami's, reindeer breeders, bring their herds in winter to the Baltic Sea, as the snow is not as deep here as it is further inland and the animals have better access to lichens and mosses. When Lapland's coast is still frozen, 300 kilometres further south in the Kvarken Archipelago, a special spectacle takes place. Millions of fish head for the coast. Barrier beaches prevent them from reaching the coastal lagoons. They can only spawn where the water is salt-free.

programme.title: To the South
programme.desc: At the first part of his journey, the photographer is lucky to get some shots of rare animal species. Between the gaps of the rocky mountains he traces funny creatures: Pica. They look like a mixture between hamsters and rabbits. From his hideout Benny Rebel manages to observe impressive Ibexes, a kind of wild goats with huge horns. Equipped with a special microcopter and night shot camera traps he tries to get a sneak into the life of shy inhabitants of the steppe. In his adventure he encounters lonesome dromedary herds and discovers a spooky cave of hyenas. Rebel witnesses owls, snakes and lizards living between the antique ruins of the old Persian capital Persepolis. Benny Rebel also is interested in the relationship between men and nature. He meets not only ranger in the wild, but also visitors of the magnificent Persian gardens in the middle of rough deserts. Between the fountains of freshly sputtering water pelicans take a bath. Young and old people walk in the green paradises in front of attractive mosques. Unexpected the 43 year old photographer meets animal lovers on the roof tops of urban houses. The bet on the flying skills of their specific breed of pigeons. programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: The Power Of Merlok
programme.desc: When Jestro attacks a village on the far side of the Kingdom, the NEXO-Knights wonder how they'll get there. Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Jestro uses the Book of Chaos to unleash, um, chaos and attack the King's hover train to try and kidnap the royal party. Can the NEXO-Knights bring order out of the chaos and save the King? Jestro finds the Book of Chaos in the countryside and decides he must feed it to the book. The Book of Monsters actually tells Jestro NOT to feed it to him he tells Jestro he's not ready for that kind of power. But Jestro doesn't listen. Now the Book unleashes chaotic monsters and Jestro uses them to attack the King and his party who are on a business-related tour of the kingdom. When the NEXO-Knights show up to stop the monster attacks and realize that they must save King and Queen Halbert – Macy's parents – from the chaotic evil monsters that have been unleashed. Clay asserts himself as leader and brings order to the knights from the chaos. He has his own book: the Book of the Knight's Code. They should all live by it.

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks

programme.title: New Girl in Town
programme.desc: When the World Petacular comes to Heartlake City and is almost ruined before it's even started, five feisty girls unite, despite their differences, using their creativity to save the day. Best friends Olivia, Andrea, Emma, Mia and Stephanie reside in HeartLake City but didn't know each other - that is until the World Petacular brought them together! On the eve of the biggest event Heartlake City hosts, disaster and chaos is abound. New-in-town Olivia is helping her veterinarian Aunt Sophie with her mobile clinic. But when she's put in charge of training a scruffy puppy named Scarlet, the puppy runs amuck, leaving a trail of destruction as she collides with Andrea, ruins Emma's banner and Stephanie's cakes, and finally spooks Mia's horse Bella who bucks Mia off and sprints away. The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

programme.title: Stephanie's Surprise Party
programme.desc: When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they soon discover that it's not easy keeping their plans secret from Stephanie who becomes suspicious when none of the girls have time to hang out. When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they discover that it's not easy keeping their plans a secret. As the girls choreograph a dance routine, magic show and search for the perfect present and cake, Stephanie becomes aware that her friends are avoiding her on her birthday and excluding her from their activities... Little does she know that her friends are secretly preparing a surprise pool party for her! Once the surprise is revealed Stephanie realises how much her friends care about her and the importance of friendship.

programme.title: Dolphin Cruise
programme.desc: Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a science contest at school and win a trip on a luxury yacht but not everything goes as planned when they set out to sea. When Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a school science contest and win a Dolphin sight-seeing trip, not everything goes to plan...As the girls set out to sea on a luxury yacht, misunderstandings and disagreements occur which become secondary when they discover a pod of dolphins in danger. The girls learn that they have to compromise and trust in each other if they are to save the dolphins and their trip out to sea...

The Ninja dismiss him as a threat, but regret that choice after Lloyd wakes up the evil snake tribe. A prophecy is revealed that states a green ninja will ultimately defeat Lord Garmadon.

programme.title: Home

programme.title: Snakebit
programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.desc: Have you ever heard that the world around is full terrible plagues and diseases? One boy called Semushka knows it for sure! Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.title: A Myth Full Of Grief And Despair About One Historical Error
programme.desc: Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn't like history lessons. The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?!

programme.title: Panic Unbearable Legend About Insects
programme.desc: Once there was a girl called Anya who was very scared of insects! One day Anya's mother asked her to help around the house but in everything she did, Anya was haunted by spiders and all kinds of midges! She was on the edge of despair when her little brother proved to her, that little crumbs can't be of any danger to giants like children!

programme.title: Happy New Year… Again!
programme.desc: Masha decides celebrating New Year once is not enough and goes to mysterious China, where dragons dance, gardens bloom and many, many more interesting things are happening!

programme.title: Like Cat And Mouse
programme.desc: Alert! Bear's fridge is in danger! Someone has burst into his house to stay for life…but the Bear is ready for everything to defend his stocks! He calls for a savior, but in reality it turns to be a new intriguing story full of unexpected discoveries which leads Masha to some peculiar conclusions!

programme.title: At Your Service
programme.desc: The technologies some time can teach us a human lesson like in this story about two robots. One of them was presented to Masha for her birthday and the other one was made by the Bear to help him around, but tried to become the boss. Everything turned into great mess and only an unexpectedly awakened feeling between two robots put everything in its place.

programme.title: All You Need is a Goal
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: Bon Appétit
programme.desc: Panda- the Bear's distant relative pays one more visit to the Bear. They start making Chinese dump-lings, but then Masha appears, with her own methods of cooking. And a simple cooking turns into a culinary master class with butterflies!

programme.title: Once In A Year
programme.desc: The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals wouldn't have a chance to forget about her party and the list of presents.The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals wouldn't have a chance to forget about her party and the list of presents.

programme.title: Prances With Wolves
programme.desc: The Wolves that live in the forest come with a plan to kidnap Masha and demand the Bear to pay a ransom. However the Bear is pleased to find Masha gone and he does not rush the events. Meanwhile Masha turns the Wolves' lives into a hell and they end up paying the ransom to the Bear just to get rid of her once and for all.

programme.title: Around the world in one day
programme.desc: The Bear is preparing to go on a world trip, but a last minute accident makes him panic. In the meantime, Masha knows the best way to prepare for the trip and shares it with the Bear.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: Tee For Three
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Masha is again playing mother and daughter with Rosie. But this time an honest lot distributed the roles. Now it's Masha's turn to put on her cap and get in the stroller. Will Rosie endure mother's everyday life?

programme.title: Terrible Power
programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: All the world's a stage
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: The Tops and the Roots
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Ali Baba
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Tom Thumb
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Wee Little Havroshechka
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Tour de Forest
programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.title: What's Inside?
programme.desc: In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. ""What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?

programme.title: Try, Try Again
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.8
programme.desc: After much struggle, Ji Young competes in the Miss Korea Seoul preliminaries and does her best, but feels overwhelmed by the offensives from Queen Beauty Salon and Seri Beauty Salon. Ji Young and the ViVi Cosmetics members go through a tense preliminary judging process. Meanwhile, Ji Young's family, realizing she went ahead with the Miss Korea pageant, appears at the preliminary venue and tries to forcibly take Ji Young away.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.9
programme.desc: Oh Ji Young, having failed to place, cannot hide her disappointment, and Hyung Joon feels sorry for her. Director Yang, having learned all the facts, proposes to Ji Young that she leave Hyung Joon and join him to compete in the main competition after Im Sun Joo steps down.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.10
programme.desc: As it is revealed that Im Sun Joo is an unmarried mother and her 'Jin' (Winner) qualification is revoked, Oh Ji Young learns that she can advance to the finals as 'Mi' (Third Place). The ViVi Cosmetics members and Teacher Jung are happy about this hard-won opportunity, but Yoon, seeing Hyung Joon and Ji Young growing closer, makes an offer to ViVi Cosmetics that is hard to refuse, leaving Hyung Joon in distress.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.11
programme.desc: The intensive training for the Miss Korea finals begins, but Seoul contestants Oh Ji Young, Kim Jae Hee, Shin Sun Young, and Choi Soo Yeon, who share a room, get into a big fight over a trivial matter and receive penalty points. Before the finals, Ji Young refuses to sign a contract stating she must become the exclusive model for BaDa Cosmetics if selected as Miss Korea, and Kang Shik threatens that it will be difficult to become Miss Korea if she doesn't sign.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.12
programme.desc: The organizers of the Miss Korea pageant receive instructions that there is a problem with the Seoul 'Jin, Seon, Mi' monopolizing the main competition as the presidential election approaches. Director Ma and Director Yang move busily, but they sense an unusual atmosphere. During the training camp, Ji Young struggles due to Shin Sun Young's jealousy. Amidst her struggles, Yoon visits Ji Young.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.13
programme.desc: Director Ma, having learned about Jae Hee's father, listens to the whole story and then sends a message to Rep. Kim Suk Chul, Jae Hee's father, asking him to leave Jae Hee alone. Hyung Joon and the ViVi Cosmetics team prepare a press conference to expose the change in judges.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.
